caveats: No battery here compares with an organisation: experts, contest entrants, contest crowds and forecaster teams.
RE-Bench: four to eight agent runs per environment; METR's own elicitation; experts had AI tools (kwa2025horizon, C.1.2), which raises their scores.
RE-Bench: the capped score ties the sides at the cap; at 16 and 32 hours the best model is at the ceiling.
Cybench: newest scores are developers' own reports, some on a 37-task subset; first-solve times count from the contest start.

MLE-bench: entries are self-submitted; old Kaggle solutions are public and may be in training data; test splits are rebuilt from training data, so the board comparison is approximate (chan2024mlebench).
MLE-bench: the run-group map after the pinned commit is a merge conflict, so the newest entry (Famou-Agent 2.0 with Gemini 3 Pro) is left out.
Forecasting: the budget is not varied; the superforecaster median is a crowd aggregate, the Metaculus Pros a team of ten in spring 2026.

rebench_th11_saturation.verdict: saturated: Claude Opus 4.6 (Inspect) is censored above the largest budget the public data can test and sits at the score's cap in every environment there, where an agent can lead by at most 1.006; the battery cannot show t* rising further

verdict_c10.b: on MLE-bench, against contest entrants, not organisations, the best entry's verdict flips on 45% of competitions when the comparison moves from the median entrant to the gold-threshold entrant: the verdict is not stable within the class unless the rank is named. The share won rises with the entry's date (rank correlation 0.97).
verdict_c10.c_estimable: RE-Bench at matched time: t* is censored below 8 h for 14 of 18 models, inside 8 to 32 h for 3 (each interval runs from below 8 h to above 32 h, four to eight runs per environment), and censored above 32 h for 1. Cybench: t* lies inside the grid for 13 of 21 models, 7 of them with an interval wholly inside it.
verdict_c10.c_rises: yes on both: rank correlation with release date 0.57 (0.16 to 0.86) on RE-Bench and 0.91 (0.65 to 0.97) on Cybench, where t* doubles every 114 days (57 to 352). Not monotone by model on RE-Bench: GPT-5.2, GPT-5.3-Codex came after the first crossing (Gemini 3 Pro) and sit below 8 h.
verdict_c10.c_saturates: saturated: Claude Opus 4.6 (Inspect) is censored above the largest budget the public data can test and sits at the score's cap in every environment there, where an agent can lead by at most 1.006; the battery cannot show t* rising further. On Cybench the curvature of ln t* is 1.58 per year squared (-4.33 to 12.01): no sign of slowing yet, but the pool's longest solve time (24.9 h) caps what can be measured. On a fixed pool t* saturates with the pool, so 'rises without saturating' is not a property t* has; it holds only while the battery's human baselines reach beyond the systems tested.
verdict_c10.forecasting: t* not identified: neither ForecastBench nor Metaculus varies the budget.
verdict_c10.mlebench_tstar: not identified, except as a lower bound: where an entry allowed 32 h or less beats an entrant's final score, t* lies above the grid's top on that competition, if neither side's score falls with time; a loss identifies nothing.

e21-clusters.label: decisive clusters with a public human comparison examined here (AI research, cyber, strategy)

e21-clusters-tstar.label: of those, clusters where t* has an interval for at least one model, censored above allowed (its lower end not censored below the grid)

e21-clusters-tstar-two-sided.label: of those, clusters where some model's t* interval lies wholly inside the tested budgets (neither end censored)

e21-cyber-ceiling-h.label: the longest first-solve time in Cybench, above which t* on this pool cannot be measured
e21-cyber-ceiling-h.note: the latest share leaves one step before t* is pinned between the two longest solve times

e21-cyber-curvature.label: curvature of ln t* against release date (negative would mean slowing)

e21-cyber-doubling-days.label: doubling time of t* on Cybench across release dates (models with t* inside the grid; least squares on ln t*)

e21-cyber-doubling-days-hi.label: that doubling time, 97.5th percentile of resampling models, tasks and solve counts

e21-cyber-doubling-days-lo.label: that doubling time, 2.5th percentile of resampling models, tasks and solve counts

e21-cyber-models.label: models with a reported unguided Cybench score and release date (best report per model)

e21-cyber-rho.label: rank correlation of Cybench t* with release date

e21-cyber-rho-hi.label: that correlation, 97.5th percentile of resampling models, tasks and solve counts

e21-cyber-rho-lo.label: that correlation, 2.5th percentile of resampling models, tasks and solve counts

e21-cyber-tstar-latest.label: t* of the latest model on Cybench against the contest field's fastest team (claude-opus-4-6_unknown, 2026-02-05; inside the tested budgets)
e21-cyber-tstar-latest.note: developer-reported score; first-solve times overstate a dedicated team's time, which raises t*

e21-cyber-tstar-latest-hi.label: that t*, 97.5th percentile of resampling tasks and solve counts (censored: above 32 h, so a lower bound)

e21-cyber-tstar-latest-lo.label: that t*, 2.5th percentile of resampling tasks and solve counts (inside the tested budgets)

e21-fb-above.label: ForecastBench tournament AI entries at or above the superforecaster median

e21-fb-llm-margin.label: best single model run by ForecastBench itself minus the superforecaster median on its baseline board

e21-fb-top-margin.label: top ForecastBench tournament entry minus the superforecaster median, Brier Index (intervals overlap)

e21-meta-decided.label: Metaculus Pro-against-bot rounds whose 95% interval excludes parity (all in the Pros' favour)

e21-mle-entries.label: MLE-bench leaderboard entries with grading reports at the pinned commit (test-set-feedback entries and ablations left out)

e21-mle-flip-best.label: share of competitions whose verdict flips when the comparison moves from the median entrant to the gold-threshold entrant

e21-mle-gold-best.label: its share beating the gold-medal threshold entrant

e21-mle-medal-2024.label: share beating the bronze-threshold entrant for the best 2024 entry (models-o1-preview-aide)

e21-mle-medal-best.label: its share beating the bronze-medal threshold entrant, a contest entrant at that rank

e21-mle-medal-best-hi.label: that share, 97.5th percentile of resampling competitions

e21-mle-medal-best-lo.label: that share, 2.5th percentile of resampling competitions

e21-mle-median-best.label: share of the 75 competitions in which the best entry beats the median Kaggle entrant (AIBuildAI, best by medal share, so biased up)

e21-mle-rho.label: rank correlation of the medal share with the entry's grading date across leaderboard entries

e21-rebench-below-8h.label: models whose t* is censored below 8 hours, the smallest budget with expert data

e21-rebench-cap-32h.label: share of resampling draws in which Claude Opus 4.6 (Inspect) is at the score's cap in every environment at 32 hours

e21-rebench-ceiling-32h.label: the largest ratio any agent can reach at 32 hours on METR's capped score (1 over the experts' best of four)
e21-rebench-ceiling-32h.note: at the ceiling a win is a tie at the cap; the battery cannot show t* rising further

e21-rebench-cross-8h.label: of those, models whose mean best score at 8 hours is at least the experts' (kappa(8 h) >= 1, point estimates)

e21-rebench-kappa32-best.label: that model's score over the experts' at 32 hours (best of four runs each side, Claude Opus 4.6 (Inspect))

e21-rebench-kappa8-best.label: that model's score over the experts' at 8 hours, mean best of one run each side (Claude Opus 4.6 (Inspect))

e21-rebench-kappa8-best-hi.label: that ratio, 97.5th percentile of resampling environments and runs

e21-rebench-kappa8-best-lo.label: that ratio, 2.5th percentile of resampling environments and runs

e21-rebench-models.label: models with matched 8-hour runs on every RE-Bench environment in METR's Time Horizon 1.1 data

e21-rebench-rho.label: rank correlation of t* (censored values ranked at their ends) with release date across those models

e21-rebench-rho-hi.label: that correlation, 97.5th percentile of resampling models, environments and runs

e21-rebench-rho-lo.label: that correlation, 2.5th percentile of resampling models, environments and runs

e21-rebench-tstar-best.label: largest crossover budget t* of any model on RE-Bench at matched time (Claude Opus 4.6 (Inspect), released 2026-02-05; censored: above 32 h, so a lower bound)
e21-rebench-tstar-best.note: capped score: 1 is the mean 8-hour expert result on the environment

e21-rebench-tstar-best-lo.label: that model's t*, 2.5th percentile of resampling environments and runs (censored: above 32 h, so a lower bound)
